in_marathi.name: Amithi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amithi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Amrita' which means 'Immortal'. In Hindu mythology, Amrita is the elixir of immortality. The name Amithi symbolizes the inner strength and resilience of a woman, who, like the elixir, nourishes and protects those around her.
